items.title: US and Iran exchange strikes after two US soldiers killed in Jordan
items.description: US forces target Iranian sites for the eighth night in a row, while Iran says it fired drones at the US military in Kuwait.

items.title: Tate brothers arrested in US as further UK charges take total to 59
items.description: The Crown Prosecution Service says it has requested their extradition from the US, while their lawyer says they are innocent.

items.title: Russia launches major ballistic missile attack on Ukrainian cities
items.description: Four people are killed and at least 36 injured as Ukraine's two largest cities are targeted, as Kyiv continues its own assault on Russian infrastructure.

items.title: Cuban dissident Luis Manuel Otero Alcántara goes into exile in US
items.description: He was arrested in 2021 during Cuba's largest anti-government protests in decades and spent five years ⁠in prison.

items.title: New EU border system tripling time at passport control, airport boss says
items.description: Ryanair has also warned passengers travelling to Europe this summer to prepare for extended waits.

items.title: Ferry carrying 116 passengers sinks off Guyana coast, authorities say
items.description: The vessel capsized between Georgetown and Port Kaituma, with 53 people so far rescued.

items.title: Hungary's president agrees to stand down after parliament backs removal
items.description: Tamás Sulyok, seen as an Orbán loyalist, had until Saturday night to agree to end his term.
